commands:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=origin
OLD_MAIN=bd2eaf90a213d3b57d412a0e2ff06965d5401ea5
GOOD=2b26f355f78d869789d719c1c14a98e87289286e
HANDOFF=a6ce97e6aa9e271256f781acab3906c1b8345824
PORTFOLIO=1a55ee690aaa7ef03aa00a09f0b5336f1f6432e2
git fetch --prune --tags "$REPO"
remote_sha() { git ls-remote --heads "$REPO" "refs/heads/$1" | awk '{print $1}'; }
[ "$(remote_sha main)" = "$OLD_MAIN" ]
[ "$(remote_sha night/link-backend-refactor-20260903)" = "$GOOD" ]
[ "$(remote_sha integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903)" = "$GOOD" ]
[ "$(remote_sha handoff/c6-20260902)" = "$HANDOFF" ]
[ "$(remote_sha portfolio/p1-quality-20260827)" = "$PORTFOLIO" ]
[ -n "$(remote_sha agent-control)" ]
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$OLD_MAIN" "$GOOD"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PORTFOLIO" "$OLD_MAIN"
[ "$(git rev-parse c6-gatewaylink-stable-2026-09-03^{})" = "a4b1f629c1286d631ac208515b71aeeaa7c44b23" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse c6-sonoff-stable-2026-09-02^{})" = "0d64fb03164d3bcb9f5cddd639977b4027bc581f" ]
git push "$REPO" "$GOOD:refs/heads/main"
[ "$(remote_sha main)" = "$GOOD" ]
git push "$REPO" --delete night/link-backend-refactor-20260903 handoff/c6-20260902 portfolio/p1-quality-20260827
[ -z "$(remote_sha night/link-backend-refactor-20260903)" ]
[ -z "$(remote_sha handoff/c6-20260902)" ]
[ -z "$(remote_sha portfolio/p1-quality-20260827)" ]
[ "$(remote_sha integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903)" = "$GOOD" ]
[ "$(remote_sha main)" = "$GOOD" ]
[ -n "$(remote_sha agent-control)" ]
printf 'BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS\n'
printf 'main=%s\n' "$(remote_sha main)"
printf 'integration=%s\n' "$(remote_sha integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903)"
printf 'remaining branches:\n'
git ls-remote --heads "$REPO" | sed 's#.*refs/heads/##' | sort
